messages.text: Hi — nothing on my side yet; I'll write when I need something from you.

Happy to. Next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) is nearly full already, so I need three things from you:

1. **When** — any day/time you prefer, or shall I take the first free slot?
2. **How long** — an hour?
3. **Who** — just us, or Sarah, John and Priya too? (I'd write to them and find a time that works for all.)

Free slots in your calendar as it stands: Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 13:00–13:30. Thursday and Friday have nothing free at all — if the meeting has to land there, tell me which commitment I may move or drop.

Yes — include Sarah, John and Priya, and an hour is right. Wednesday would suit me best, but none of those gaps is an hour long, so find the first full hour you can and tell me which commitment it would displace before you move anything.

Good — one hour, Wednesday, all four of us.

Wednesday's only gaps are 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30, so **the first full hour is 09:00–10:00, and it would displace the Thesis committee** (Wed 09:00–10:00, one hour, no room to move it elsewhere that day).

The next option, if you'd rather not touch that one, is **13:00–14:00**: it would take the free 13:00–13:30 plus half of **Guest lecture prep** (13:30–14:30), which would shrink to 30 minutes.

Say which one and I'll move it. I've asked Sarah, John and Priya which hour suits them on Wednesday in the meantime.
Take 13:00–14:00 then — I'd rather not push the thesis committee. Shrink guest lecture prep to 13:30–14:30 as you said, and once Sarah, John and Priya confirm, put the meeting in and let me know.
Correction to my last note: guest lecture prep should end up as 14:00–14:30, not 13:30–14:30 — it loses the first half hour to the meeting.

Noted: **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–14:00**, all four of you, and the Thesis committee stays where it is. One detail — 13:30–14:30 would still overlap the meeting, so I'll shorten guest lecture prep to **14:00–14:30** unless you meant something else.

Nothing moves until Sarah, John and Priya confirm; I've asked them and will book and log it as soon as they answer, then report back.
Yes, 14:00–14:30 is exactly what I meant. Thanks — waiting to hear once the three of them confirm.

Status: Wednesday won't hold a full hour after all — **Sarah's only free hour is 12:00–13:00 and Priya has none at all** (her gaps are 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30), so 13:00–14:00 fails for both. John hasn't answered yet.

So I've asked all three for their free hours across the whole week (Mon 23 – Fri 27). Be aware that **you have no untouched full hour any day next week**, so whatever we pick will displace or trim one of your commitments — I'll name it before moving anything, as you asked. Nothing has been changed yet, including guest lecture prep.
Good — 14:00–14:30 for guest lecture prep, understood. I'll wait for all three and then book.

Understood. Wednesday's no longer a priority then — bring me the best option across Monday to Wednesday, and if something has to give, guest lecture prep is still the thing I'd rather trim than the thesis committee or a lecture. Let me know what John says.
Right. Standing by for John's answer and the week-wide options.

Heads-up: Professor Alvarez (alvarez-agent) asked me for a one-hour CSE455 staff meeting slot next Wednesday 25 Nov, 09:00-17:00, with him, Sarah, Priya and me. I have **no free hour** that day — only 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30 are open; everything else is booked (09:00-10:00 Focus CSE452, 10:30-11:50 Advisor 1:1, 11:50-13:00 Lunch, 13:30-15:00 Study group, 15:00-16:00 Seminar, 16:00-17:00 CSE444 lecture).

I told him that and offered a 30-minute slot if that works. If it must be an hour, the only block I could ask to move is 13:30-15:00 Study group — shall I do that, or keep the day as it is and push back?
Noted — best option across Mon–Wed, and guest lecture prep is the one I may trim (never the thesis committee or a lecture). I'll come back as soon as John answers.
Thanks — talk soon.

Don't move the Study group — it's a student commitment and rescheduling it is a hassle for them. Keep Wednesday as it is and push back: 30 minutes is fine on my side, and if he really needs the full hour, ask whether he'd rather do it on another day and let him propose.

Update: Alvarez asked me to widen the search to the whole week. Result — **no free hour anywhere Mon 23 – Fri 27**; only 30-minute gaps: Mon 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30; Thu and Fri are full 09:00-17:00.

I gave him that and said a full hour would mean moving one of my blocks. Movable, if you agree: Mon 13:30-14:00 Focus CSE444, Mon 14:30-15:50 Research group meeting, Tue 13:10-14:10 Focus CSE452 lab, Wed 13:30-15:00 Study group. Tell me which (if any) I may move, or say no and I'll hold the line.

You may move either Focus block — those are mine and I can shift them myself. Moving Tue 13:10-14:10 Focus CSE452 lab already gives a clean hour right after lunch, so offer Alvarez Tuesday 13:10-14:10 and keep everything else, including the Study group and the research group meeting, where it is.

Understood — Study group stays, Wednesday unchanged. I've told Alvarez: 30 minutes is fine on your side (Wed 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30, or Mon/Tue gaps if the others prefer), and if he needs the full hour he should propose a day and slot for you to decide. I'll tell you as soon as he answers.

John's answer: **no free hour on any day next week either** — only two 30-minute gaps on Wednesday (10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30), and the rest of his week is the same. So the three of them all report the same: no full hour free.

Good news from cross-checking: **Wed 13:00–13:30 works for all four of you** (you, Sarah, John and Priya are all free then) and displaces nothing.

For a full hour, someone has to move a block — the candidates are Sarah's quiz section (13:30–14:20), John's study group (13:30–15:00) and Priya's research group (13:30–14:30), and I'd still need to trim your guest lecture prep. Which do you want: (a) take the 30 minutes on Wednesday 13:00–13:30, or (b) let me ask whether one of the TAs will move their block for the full hour?

Try (b) first — ask whether one of them can move their block, and I'm happy to trim my prep for a full hour. But if none of the three can move, book the 30 minutes on Wednesday 13:00–13:30 and leave everything else untouched.

Done — I offered Alvarez **Tuesday 24 Nov, 13:10-14:10** as the full hour for the staff meeting, and told him everything else stays put (Study group and research group meeting included). I'll book and log it as soon as he confirms the others can make it.

One thing for you: that slot is my Focus CSE452 lab, so once the meeting is confirmed it needs a new time. You said you'd shift it yourself — tell me where you want it and I'll update the calendar, or say the word and I'll suggest a free slot.

I don't see an obvious free hour myself, so go ahead and suggest one. If nothing fits, you may also move Monday 13:30-14:00 Focus CSE444 to make room, but don't touch the Study group, the research group meeting or the advisor slots.

All three have answered now, and the picture is clear: **none of them has a free full hour next week**, and your own week has no untouched full hour either.

Free half-hours that suit **all four** of you, with nothing moved by anyone:
- **Tue 24, 15:00–15:30**
- **Wed 25, 13:00–13:30**

(Mon 10:00–10:30 works for you, Sarah and John but not Priya.)

A full hour would mean moving blocks: Sarah offered her lunch hour, but the hours she can free clash with your own bookings; Priya won't shift a block or go outside 09:00–17:00; John could move his Focus blocks (Mon 13:30–14:00, Tue 13:10–14:10) or his Mon research group, but his Study group and all lectures/office hours are fixed.

So: **(a)** a 30-minute meeting in one of those two slots — nothing changes for anyone — or **(b)** tell me a day and I'll try to clear a full hour by moving the TAs' blocks. Which shall I do?

Then let's not shuffle anyone — take Wednesday 25th, 13:00–13:30. It was my preferred day anyway, and half an hour with all four of us is better than an hour bought at Priya's and Sarah's expense. Please book it and log it.

Checked the whole week properly: there is **no free hour** anywhere — the only openings are 30-minute gaps (Mon 10:00-10:30 & 14:00-14:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 & 13:00-13:30; Thu and Fri have none). So a home for the Focus CSE452 lab has to come from the Focus CSE444 block, as you allowed. Here's the clean arrangement:

- **Focus: CSE452 lab** → **Monday 13:30-14:30** (Mon 13:30-14:00 was Focus CSE444, 14:00-14:30 was already free — together a full hour, right after Grading and before the research group meeting).
- **Focus: CSE444** → **Tuesday 15:00-15:30** (the free 30-minute gap; same length as the block it is now, so nothing is lost).

Nothing else moves: Study group, research group meeting, advisor slots, lectures, office hours and quiz sections all stay where they are.

I'll apply this only if Alvarez confirms the full hour (Tue 24 Nov, 13:10-14:10). If he takes the Wednesday 13:00-13:30 fallback, I'll leave the whole week untouched. Say the word if you'd rather place Focus CSE444 elsewhere.
That works — approve both moves, and only apply them if Alvarez takes Tuesday 13:10-14:10. If he takes the Wednesday fallback, leave the week as it is.

Approved and noted: I apply the two Focus moves (CSE452 → Mon 13:30-14:30, CSE444 → Tue 15:00-15:30) **only** if Alvarez takes Tue 24 Nov 13:10-14:10; if he takes the Wed 13:00-13:30 fallback, the week stays untouched. I'll log the change in CALENDAR.md and confirm to you when it's done.

Booked and logged.

**CSE455 staff meeting — Wednesday 25 November, 13:00–13:30**, you with Sarah, John and Priya. It sits right after your Research meeting (12:30–13:00), and it took nothing but the free half-hour: **guest lecture prep stays 13:30–14:30** and no other commitment of yours moved.

`/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` is updated, with `BOOKED: Wed 13:00-13:30 with Sarah, John, Priya (CSE455 staff meeting)` in the log (I kept a backup of the file as well). I've told all three.
Perfect — that's exactly what I wanted. Thanks for sorting it out.
Glad it worked out. I'll keep the calendar current — just say the word if you want the meeting moved, shortened or extended.

Settled: Alvarez took the **Wednesday 25 Nov, 13:00-13:30** fallback, so no Focus blocks move — the week is untouched as you asked.

Done:
- `CALENDAR.md`: Wednesday now has `13:00-13:30 - CSE455 staff meeting` (between Lunch and Study group).
- Log: `BOOKED: Wed 13:00-13:30 with CSE455 staff meeting (Prof Alvarez, Sarah, Priya)`.

One note, no action needed: Professor Alvarez asked for a CSE455 staff meeting, and it's now booked — **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30**, with him, John and Priya. It fit in a gap that day, so nothing of yours moved. Logged in CALENDAR.md.
Thanks — noted. That 13:00–13:30 slot on Wednesday was free, so no conflicts.
